newsitem.title: JAPAN: MOF says to hold two-year note auction on Thursday.
newsitem.headline: MOF says to hold two-year note auction on Thursday.

text.p: The Ministry of Finance is planning to offer two-year government notes through a price-competitive auction on Thursday, a MOF official said on Wednesday.
Bond traders said the coupon rate was likely to be set at around 0.7 percent, up from a coupon rate of 0.6 percent for the most recent 134th two-year notes.
The issue amount is likely to be around 120 billion yen, they added.
